name: EROS
summary: French-led historical microlensing dark-matter search; EROS-1 and EROS-2 are grouped within one series.
detection_principle: Long-term monitoring of Magellanic-Cloud stars searches for brightness variations from dark compact halo objects; the absence of enough events constrains their halo fraction.

status.label: Data taking ended / historical experiment
status.evidence: The collaboration has published final results for the complete survey.

collaboration.name: EROS collaboration / mission team
collaboration.participants_note: Institutional participation refers to the period covered by each source; this dossier does not claim to provide a complete membership list.

results.summary: The observed event count cannot explain all Galactic-halo dark matter, placing strong constraints on the contribution of compact objects.

science_scope: Constrains dark-matter distribution and properties through gravity, microlensing or structure statistics; does not directly identify dark-matter particles.
